Seeds a 1024-slot particle pool at 0x02010018 (stride 28, field 0x18=-1 marks a slot free) and a 16-entry per-index table at work+0x7080 (positions/heights seeded from Func_08004458() and clamped against Data_080eeb4b[Func_080022fc(i,3)]), then runs a byte-table-bounded (Data_080eeb5e[object->0x18]) sequence of frames. Each frame conditionally shows a HUD countdown near the end, and -- while more than 4 frames remain -- runs a nested spC-inner loop (bounded by the same Data_080eeb5e byte) that: sometimes toggles work->0x77A8, draws a rectangle through rectangle_slot[1 & idx] using one of two parallel Data_080eeb4[48/4E]/[54/58] table pairs selected by mode (with an extra Data_080eeb71 clamp in the mode!=0 case), dispatches Func_080d6888 once per listed member (object field 0x24, stride 2, object field 0x14 count) at a specific milestone frame, and at two other milestones claims one free slot from a SEPARATE 512-slot pool at 0x02010000.
